info.title: DoD OTA 10 USC 4022 Prototype White Paper API
info.description: Converts commercial dual-use technology specifications and DoD Problem Statements / Commercial Solutions Openings (CSOs) / Request for Prototype Proposals (RPPs) across DIU, C5ISR/CECOM, SOSSEC, SpEC, MTEC, NSTXL, and AFWERX into a 10 U.S.C. 4022 statutory eligibility assessment, evaluator-ready OTA Prototype White Paper sections, a Fixed-Price Payable Milestone Schedule & ROM, a Phase 3 Sole-Source Follow-On Production Strategy under 10 U.S.C. 4022(f), and an OTA IP & Data Rights posture. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Generate DoD OTA (10 U.S.C. 4022) Prototype White Paper & Milestone Schedule
post.description: Converts commercial dual-use technology specs and DoD Problem Statements (DIU, C5ISR, SOSSEC, SpEC, MTEC, NSTXL) into a 10 U.S.C. 4022 OTA Prototype White Paper, NDC Justification, Payable Milestone Schedule, and Phase 3 Follow-On Production Strategy.

commercial_solution_and_problem_topic_te.description: DoD Problem Statement / CSO / RPP topic description (DIU, C5ISR/CECOM, SOSSEC, SpEC, MTEC, NSTXL) and vendor's dual-use commercial technology, TRL, and architecture.

target_ota_consortium_and_pathway.description: Target OTA pathway or consortium (e.g., DIU Commercial Solutions Opening [CSO], SOSSEC, SpEC Space Enterprise Consortium, C5ISR, NSTXL, AFWERX).

nontraditional_contractor_and_cost_share.description: 10 U.S.C. 4022 statutory eligibility posture: Nontraditional Defense Contractor (NDC), Small Business, or Traditional Defense Contractor with NDC sub / 1/3 cost-share.

example.commercial_solution_and_problem_topic_te: DIU Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Topic: Autonomous Counter-UAS & Contested Logistics RF Situational Awareness. DoD Problem: Forward operating bases require a low-SWaP, passive RF and electro-optical sensor fusion node capable of detecting Group 1-3 autonomous drones in GPS-denied environments without emitting targetable radar signatures. Vendor Commercial Solution: AegisRF Commercial Edge v3.4 (currently TRL 6, deployed across 14 commercial airports and critical energy substations, $18M Series A funded). Uses passive time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) SDR arrays and quantized neural edge inference on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Industrial to classify 400+ RF protocols in < 120ms.
